annotation.title_clean: Regulation (EU) 2021/1068 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 24 June 2021 amending Regulation (EU) 2016/1628 as regards its transitional provisions for certain machinery fitted with engines in the power ranges greater than or equal to 56 kW and less than 130 kW, and greater than or equal to 300 kW, in order to address the impact of the COVID-19 crisis
annotation.title_en: Regulation (EU) 2021/1068 amending Regulation (EU) 2016/1628 as regards transitional provisions for certain machinery fitted with engines, to address the impact of the COVID-19 crisis
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: EU regulation extending transitional provisions of Regulation 2016/1628 on emission limits and type-approval for non-road mobile machinery engines (56–130 kW and ≥300 kW) because of COVID-19 supply disruptions. It is unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Extends the transition period for placing on the market of machinery with certain engines by nine months
Extends the production period by six months
Enters into force on the day of publication
Justified by COVID-19 supply chain disruption with no environmental impact
